name: Dress
summary:
This red dress for a young girl is from the Spring/Summer 2011 range from Stella McCarthney Kids. McCartney's first collection for children was launched the previous November, to critical acclaim. 

This dress typifies the 2011 collection in its use of bright colour, delicate bird prints and motif
